title: Wish World
description:
Wish World
Your boss sent you on a mission to help mend and repair a nearby planet, upon arriving you notice things are either off gone or missing, its your job to fix it!

Leap into the Wish World, a unique plane of existence filled with adventure! Around the world of Wish, the world is unfinished and must be restored!

Jump into the past and future using dimensional doors! Reach the end of each level to obtain a Wish, Collect all of the worlds wish's and bring them to
the worlds heart! 

Do You Have What It Takes to Save the World!Features• Fluid Platforming

• Collection Marathon

• Colourful World

• Friendly Controls

• Difficult
Extra InfoWish world Was made individually by one person over a course of 6 years. I hope you enjoy the game as much as I did making it, the game has a story since a recent update and many changes where added.

Made with speed running in mind.

I hope you enjoy wish world! <3
description_short: Sent on a mission to explore and help the people of a nearby planet, many things on Wish world are in need of repair and mending, can you repair the world of WISH WORLD?
